proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case app _ _ _ _ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl with val_l | ⟨_, red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl with val_r | ⟨_, red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨_, .abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp _ _ _ _ der sub ih =>
    right
    
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨_, .tabs val.lc h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp h red⟩
  case let' _ _ t₂ _ L der h ih _ =>
    right
    
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body val b₂⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind red b₂⟩
  case inl _ _ ih => exact (ih rfl).elim (.inl ∘ .inl) fun ⟨_, r⟩ => .inr ⟨_, .inl r⟩
  case inr _ _ ih => exact (ih rfl).elim (.inl ∘ .inr) fun ⟨_, r⟩ => .inr ⟨_, .inr r⟩
  case case _ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    
    
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨_, red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      · cases val; exact ⟨_, .case_inl ‹_› b₂ b₃⟩
      · cases val; exact ⟨_, .case_inr ‹_› b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case red b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl
  case abs =>
    exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs _ ‹_›).wf.2.1)
  case tabs =>
    exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs _ ‹_›).wf.2.1)
